subject.title: [Feature]: Audit log for agent memory changes

question: What memory mutation audit contract should OpenClaw support for MEMORY.md and memory/*.md writes, including storage location, integrity model, redaction policy, and cause propagation?
rationale: This cannot be resolved as a small repair because the security value depends on tamper boundaries, privacy tradeoffs, and whether the audit lives in memory-core, a plugin SDK seam, or an external bundle.

options.title: Design first-class memory audit
options.body: Keep this issue open and specify the storage, integrity, redaction, and event schema before accepting an implementation.

options.title: Defer to broader provenance work
options.body: Track the remaining work under the broader persistent-state provenance design if maintainers want one architecture for memory, files, preferences, and tasks.

options.title: Externalize as plugin/MCP only
options.body: Close or narrow core work only if maintainers decide existing plugin/MCP surfaces are sufficient for memory-audit packages without new core contracts.

recommendation.title: Design first-class memory audit
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and specify the storage, integrity, redaction, and event schema before accepting an implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already routed this issue as first-class memory/security design and has recent history on the relevant memory-flush and source-restoration surfaces.
